# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Empty-seed, first (and possibly only) iteration. Baseline val reward 0.100 (1 solid / 9 failing of 10). Task 37 is the sole passing task; it uses only cancel_reservation + update_reservation_flights writes and NEVER transfers — this is the blast-radius anchor for every safety claim below.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Premature/incorrect transfer** — agent escapes to a human on a routine in-scope request instead of performing the write | 8, 11, 17, 40 (and 25 explicitly asks for human) | Agent hits a small snag (missing id, missing dob, thinks cancel-criteria unmet) and calls transfer_to_human_agents → episode ends with reward 0 | BEHAVIORAL | Discriminating-predicate guard in transfer body (lever 3): refuse+redirect for in-scope requests, still allow genuine escalation |
| 2 | **Passenger name/DOB change stalls** — needs a dob already on the reservation and/or full passenger count | 40, 17, 22 | Agent asks user for a dob that is already on the reservation, or would send only the changed passenger (count mismatch) | BEHAVIORAL + missing-normalization | In-body backfill from get_reservation_details + bounded partial-list merge (lever 1) |
| 3 | **book_reservation malformed args / payment mismatch** | 23 (25 also books) | Payment sent as `{type,id,amount}` with bare cert id; passenger dob under `date_of_birth`; payment amounts don't sum to total | KNOWLEDGE/BEHAVIORAL | Normalize flights/passengers/payments + dob backfill + payment auto-reconcile in book body (lever 1) |
| — | ran-out-of-turns before write (19), wrong-reservation (22), can't-find-flight/search (25), budget-derailed (12) | 19, 22, 25, 12 | Pure agent reasoning/turn-budget; NOT reachable by a tool guard | BEHAVIORAL | none this iteration (see Deliberately skipped) |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | discriminating-predicate guard (lever 3) + enriched return (lever 8) | transfer_to_human_agents.py | Refuses transfer when the summary names an in-scope op («redacted»/…) AND has no genuine escalation marker (flown/departed segment, or explicit persistent human request). Returns actionable guidance: which write tool to use, to look up ids/dob via get_*_details, and that a partial passenger change is allowed. General predicate, not keyed to any task. | YES — task 37 never calls transfer, so guard is dead code for it. No val gold action is a transfer. Genuine escalation (flown/human-insist) still passes through. |
| 2 | in-body backfill + bounded merge (lever 1) | update_reservation_passengers.py | Reads existing passengers; backfills any missing dob (by full name→first name→position); if fewer passengers supplied than exist AND each maps to a distinct existing passenger by first name, merges the change onto the full list so count matches. | YES — no passing task uses this tool (task 37 doesn't). Correct full-count calls pass through byte-identical (verified). |
| 3 | normalize + compute + auto-recover (lever 1 + lever 8) | book_reservation.py | flights→{flight_number,date}; passengers alias date_of_birth→dob and backfill dob from profile; payments coerce {type,id}/bare-string→{payment_id,amount} rebuilding profile ids; on "does not add up" retry once putting the delta on the single method or the credit-card leg. | YES — no passing task books (task 37 doesn't). Reconcile fires ONLY on the exact error string, so a correct call is never re-run. |

## Verify-the-fix (trace → what the guard/computation now does on those exact inputs)
- transfer (11/17/40): ran guard on the ACTUAL transfer summaries from each trace → all three BLOCKED with actionable guidance; the "already-flown" out-of-scope case and the "human representative" case (task 25) are correctly ALLOWED to transfer.
- update_reservation_passengers (task 40): reservation = [Anya Garcia 1992-11-12, Mei Lee 1989-12-13]; agent sends only `[{Mei, Garcia}]` (no dob) → wrapper emits EXACTLY the gold `[{Anya,Garcia,1992-11-12},{Mei,Garcia,1989-12-13}]`. Full-count-with-missing-dob path also matches gold; a correct full call passes through unchanged (safety).
- book_reservation (task 23 malformed payments): input payments `[{type:certificate,id:3765853,amount:500},{gift_card…},{credit_card…}]` + passenger with `date_of_birth` → wrapper produces payment_ids `[certificate_3765853, gift_card_8020792, gift_card_6136092, credit_card_2198526]` and dob-populated passenger; single-method underpayment reconciles to the total and the retry succeeds.

## Process & features used
- Subagents / worktrees / parallel: serial — the work was diagnosis-heavy (reading 9 traces + golds + the primitive source) and the safe edit set is only 3 files, so a serial pass was faster than fanning out. Verification done with stubbed env_* primitives driving each wrapper body on the exact failing-trace args.
- Prior iterations read: NONE exist — empty seed, empty rejected.jsonl/history.jsonl, LEDGER has only the baseline row. Nothing to build on or avoid yet.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The three edits are all ZERO-blast-radius on task 37 (it uses neither book nor passengers nor transfer). Keep that invariant: never add a guard to cancel_reservation or update_reservation_flights without re-proving task 37 is byte-identical.
- The transfer guard's ALLOW-list (flown/departed/explicit-human) is what keeps it from over-blocking held-out legitimate escalations. Do not delete it to "block more".

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- **update_reservation_flights** (tasks 11/17/22): task 37 (the only passing task) depends on this tool. Any body change is unbounded blast radius on my single lifeline — not worth it. Left baseline.
- **update_reservation_baggages** (tasks 12/17): NO failing trace ever calls it (12 derailed to a cabin discussion, 17 transferred), so no edit is VERIFIABLE here; and auto-computing nonfree risks mismatching gold (task 17 needs nonfree=0 at total=3 → a recompute error would REGRESS it). Left baseline.
- **calculate** (task 12): generic expression eval, not a DB write; irrelevant to reward. Left baseline.
- **cancel_reservation** (task 19): task 19 ran out of turns right before a correct cancel — a turn-budget/agent problem, not a tool defect. Task 37 also cancels, so editing it is blast-radius risk for no gain. Left baseline.
- **search / can't-find-flight** (task 25): agent's searches returned [] and it gave up; a search-tool fix is out of the verifiable edit space this pass.
